title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

How “Bitcoin falls below $50,000 by December 31, 2026” matches “Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?”

The two venues disagree on the same touch by about four cents (Polymarket 0.22, Kalshi 0.265) and no figure sits inside both books. Kalshi's is about eight times deeper ($4,000 against $500), so I take Kalshi's price and keep Polymarket's as a second reading that says the true figure may be a little lower.
